result.title: WoodBR-Cross: A public wood-image dataset and individual-tree-disjoint benchmark for species identification
result.summary: Wood-image benchmarks can yield optimistic estimates when images from the same tree occur in both training and test sets. WoodBR-Cross contains 4,875 transverse-surface images in 38 operational taxonomic classes, linked to 303 distinct trees identified by numeric catalogue witness codes (codigos-testemunho) in the Brazilian Forest Service collection. A species-level subset comprises 3,406 images, 20 classes and 214 trees. Three tasks compare duplicate-aware image partitions for all classes (A), image partitions for the species subset (B1), and individual-tree-disjoint partitions for that subset (B2). In B2, all images from each tree are kept together, so no tree is shared across training, validation or test within a fold. ResNet-50, ConvNeXt-Tiny and ViT-B/16 were evaluated with three outer folds, internal validation and five training seeds. Handcrafted and frozen-feature baselines complement border-only and randomized-label controls. Validation-selected ConvNeXt-Tiny achieved B2 tree-level macro-F1 of 0.8621 +/- 0.0317; frozen DINOv2 features yielded 0.9000 +/- 0.0722. Values are means and standard deviations across three seed-averaged fold means. Results estimate performance on previously unseen trees from this collection.

AI.brief_summary: 论文构建 WoodBR-Cross 木材横截面图像数据集（4,875 张、38 个操作分类单元，关联 303 棵独立树），并设置「整树不重叠」划分任务，用 ResNet-50、ConvNeXt-Tiny、ViT-B/16 及冻结 DINOv2 特征比较物种识别性能。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「个体不重叠划分 + 随机标签对照」的评测思路可供核查，可能用于检验 VLM 是否依赖真实视觉证据而非记忆或捷径（对应 LVR 的视觉旁路与证据使用问题），但论文本身不涉及多模态推理或 latent 状态，联系较远。
